review.tagline: Research-oriented CLI agent that runs software engineering tasks with LLM tools
review.summary: Trae Agent is a Python CLI that takes a natural-language task and runs an LLM loop with bash, file-edit, sequential-thinking and task-done tools. It works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure, OpenRouter, Doubao and Ollama, and can run tasks inside Docker containers. It records full trajectories to JSON and is built to be modified for agent research.
review.audience: Developers and researchers who want a hackable terminal coding agent
strengths: Many providers, including Ollama for local models, plus custom base_url support
Trajectory files log LLM calls, steps and tool use for debugging and analysis
Can run tasks in a new or existing Docker container, or one built from a Dockerfile
Optional MCP servers configured in YAML; modular code aimed at ablation studies
weaknesses: Terminal only; no IDE extension or web UI described
Installed from source with uv and Python 3.12+; no release published
Config is YAML with a legacy JSON format; tabs are not allowed
README says the project is still under active development
needs: Needs uv, Python 3.12+, LLM provider API key, Docker (optional)
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure, OpenRouter
